card.name: The word see before section cross-references
card.fires_on: The word "see" right after an opening bracket, just before a named label section such as Warnings and Precautions or Use in Specific Populations. It also fires weakly on a few small words in patent or technical text.

modes.label: Cross-reference 'see'
modes.description: The word "see" inside a bracket that points to another section of the label.
modes.example: CONTRAVE is not approved for use in pediatric patients [<<see>> Warnings and Precautions (5

modes.label: Small words in patent or tech text
modes.description: A small word such as in, the or of in patent-law or computing prose.
modes.example: Rivest is an inventor of<< the>> RSA public"key cryptosystem.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like letter and CESS and away from specification and disclosure, so it gives no clear cross-reference output.
card.plain: It marks the word "see" in a bracketed pointer to another section of the drug label.
